body.name: Equivalence of balanced kernels under unit relabelling
body.construction: For \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_N\), define \((\Omega^{\pi})_{abij}=\Omega_{ab,\pi(i),\pi(j)}\). Write \(\Omega\cong\Omega'\) exactly when \(\Omega'=\Omega^{\pi}\) for some \(\pi\), and set \([\Omega]_{\cong}=\{\Omega^{\pi}:\pi\in\mathfrak S_N\}\).
